quote: Do not beg to sit at tables you were never invited to. Do not chase people who exclude or ignore you. Do not seek healing from those who hurt you. Do not sell yourself out, just to fit into someone else's circle. Do not set yourself on fire to keep others warm. If you have to beg for a place, you're already in the wrong room.
